QUOTE: `include/mbedtls/constant_time.h` exposes only `mbedtls_ct_memcmp`. The wider set (`mbedtls_ct_uint_eq`, `_lt`, `_if`, `_memcpy_if`, `_bool_or`, and so on) is internal, in `library/constant_time_internal.h`.
